_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - BBS P519 V436 (battery backup sounder, S32K311, LIN). Paths are relative to this file when it is placed at <repo>/SPA2_SPA3/swit/swit_project.json. Copy and adapt for another project; nothing in the scripts depends on these values.

extra_anchors._why: BBS 评审约定：BSW 组件定义计入资源消耗矩阵

exclusions.name: MCAL (NXP RTD S32K3)
exclusions.reason: COTS vendor driver, qualified by supplier; stubbed at DRV boundary

exclusions.name: BSW LIN stack (LinIf/LinTp/Com/Dcm/PduR)
exclusions.reason: COTS AUTOSAR stack generated by EAS; stubbed at RTE/Callout boundary

target._comment: Use the map of the build that produced the software version under test (Release/production configuration preferred; Debug -O0 is much larger). check_resources warns when the map is older than the sources.

environment_difference: Host SIL on x86-64 (MinGW gcc 14, -O0, gcov instrumentation) versus target S32K311 Cortex-M7 (arm-none-eabi gcc 10.2, S32DS 3.5). Component code is compiled unchanged; MCAL/BSW/OS are replaced by CMock stubs at the DRV/RTE boundary, the OS tick is driven by the test. Timing is judged in scheduler ticks, never wall-clock; execution time, CPU load and interrupt latency are transferred to SWE.6. Endianness (little) and int width (32-bit) are identical; pointer width differs (64 vs 32-bit) and is checked by the build warnings.
